FN-OZSTMJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 76
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/09/2023
Senate Bill 76 as introduced would decrease Public Utilities License Tax receipts to the State
General Fund by an undetermined amount annually by redistributing a portion of those receipts
to the Alabama Forestry Commission, to establish a grant program that provides funds for: (1)
the maintenance, repair, replacement, and construction of rural county bridges; and (2) support
of logging workforce development and advance research and implementation of technologies
that improve forest product harvesting and transportation efficiencies. This bill would increase
the administrative obligations of the Commission to facilitate the grant program, which could be
offset by the 5% administrative holdback provided by this bill.

FN-OZSTMJ-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 76
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/11/2023
Senate Bill 76 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation General Fund would
increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Forestry Commission to implement and
administer the provisions of this bill to provide grants from the newly established Logging
Efficiency Grant Fund, as follows: (1) 85% for grants to county commissions for the
maintenance, repair, replacement, and construction of rural county bridges; (2) 10% for grants to
support logging workforce development, advance research and implementation of technologies
that improve forest product harvesting and transportation efficiencies; and (3) 5% to be retained
by the Alabama Forestry Commission to facilitate the grant programs, established by this bill.
This bill further provides that the Logging Efficiency Grant Fund shall consist of revenue
sources as directed by and at the discretion of the Legislature, appropriations as directed by, and
at the discretion of, the Legislature, and funds from any other lawful source.

FN-OZSTMJ-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 76
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/19/2023
Senate Bill 76 as passed the Senate would create the Logging Efficiency Grant Fund in the State
Treasury to be administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission to fund a grant program to
provide grants as follows: (1) 85% to county commissions for maintenance, repair, replacement,
and construction of public rural bridges; and (2) 10% for support of logging workforce
development and advance research and implementation of technologies that improve forest
product harvesting and transportation efficiencies. This bill would also increase the obligations
of the Commission to administer the grant program, which would be offset, in whole or in part,
by the 5% administrative holdback provided by this bill.
